snippet.title: James 1:17 (Jesus Is King) - Kid Rock [Official Music Video}
snippet.description:
Kid Rock’s new video, “James 1:17 (Jesus Is King),” is the first single from his upcoming album Halfway 2 Jesus.  

James 1:17 is a Bible verse from the New Testament book of James that teaches every good thing comes from God.
 
The video is dedicated to Jimmie Bones and Kalvin Lynch. 

Jimmie is the keyboard player of The Twisted Brown Trucker Band since inception, currently battling ALS. Kalvin has an inoperable brain tumor and his Make a Wish was to play drums with Kid Rock. 

The video closes with a special clip of The Miraculous Love Kids performing the song from Pakistan. Please visit them at miraculouslovekids.org 

God is good and may he show favor on them all 

Credits:
Songwriters: Robert James Ritchie  
Produced by: Kid Rock
Engineered by: Dan Frizsell
Mixed by: Malay and Kid Rock
Asst. Engineer: Gavin Mellberg
Lead Vocal: Kid Rock
Electric Guitar: Tom Bukovac
Electric Guitar: JD Simo
Drums: Rowan Stewart
Bass: Steven Pierce
Keyboards: Jim "Moose" Brown
Background Singer: Herschel Boone
Background Singer: Shannon Curfman
Background Singer: Amanda Gene Rowland

See you in the Arena!

snippet.description:
LANTERNS Episode 8 Trailer Teases Hal Jordan's SECRETS & Sinestro's MASTER PLAN?! - Time to break down the Lanterns Episode 8 trailer, featuring new footage from Lanterns Episode 8! We break down the major teases about the mystery surrounding Hal Jordan's death, new scenes showing Hal before his death, and the possibility that Hal may have helped free Sinestro. We also take a closer look at John Stewart receiving a new Lantern battery from Sinestro in the Lanterns finale, what this could mean for the origins of the Yellow Lantern Corps, and theories of John Stewart becoming a Yellow Lantern. Is Sinestro trying to create the Yellow Lanterns, and could the theory of Parallax being within Hal Jordan be true? The trailer also teases us John Stewart taking flight, while Guy Gardner warns John about being hunted by a mysterious character. Plus we break down the mystery surrounding Noah Macon and if he's secretly a Manhunter, how he could help Hal Jordan, and does he want to avenge Zoe Macon? As always we cover the biggest DCU easter eggs, hidden details and theories surrounding Lanterns 1x08. The new DCU series introduces Hal Jordan and John Stewart as they investigate a dark mystery in Rushville that could have major implications for the future of the DC Universe. Watch Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook on Apple TV.

What is Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook about?
The eight-episode series follows Nora Lum, aka Awkwafina, on a cross-country culinary road trip as she attempts to revive her family’s beloved Chinese restaurant. Her family ran Lum’s, the iconic Cantonese restaurant in Flushing, New York. Nora inherited the family legacy. The cooking skills? Those still need work. Nora admits, “I can’t cook. Like, at all.” With help from acclaimed chefs, celebrated restaurateurs and her family, she sets out to build her kitchen skills, explore contemporary Asian American cuisine and reimagine Lum’s legacy for a new generation.

Where does Awkwafina travel to in Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook?
Nora takes a crash course at the Culinary Institute of America, hits the road for Texas barbecue with Jimmy O. Yang, and learns from culinary icons Roy Choi and Martin Yan. In Hawai‘i, she explores the tiki culture that inspired her grandma’s restaurant before taking on the challenges of opening a restaurant in Los Angeles’ Chinatown. It all builds toward one high-stakes opening night, and the toughest VIP diner of all: her grandma.

What are other shows and movies like Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook?
Shows similar to Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook are The Reluctant Traveler With Eugene Levy and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars.

What is Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook about?
The eight-episode series follows Nora Lum, aka Awkwafina, on a cross-country culinary road trip as she attempts to revive her family’s beloved Chinese restaurant. Her family ran Lum’s, the iconic Cantonese restaurant in Flushing, New York. Nora inherited the family legacy. The cooking skills? Those still need work. Nora admits, “I can’t cook. Like, at all.” With help from acclaimed chefs, celebrated restaurateurs and her family, she sets out to build her kitchen skills, explore contemporary Asian American cuisine and reimagine Lum’s legacy for a new generation.

Where does Awkwafina travel to in Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook?
Nora takes a crash course at the Culinary Institute of America, hits the road for Texas barbecue with Jimmy O. Yang, and learns from culinary icons Roy Choi and Martin Yan. In Hawai‘i, she explores the tiki culture that inspired her grandma’s restaurant before taking on the challenges of opening a restaurant in Los Angeles’ Chinatown. It all builds toward one high-stakes opening night, and the toughest VIP diner of all: her grandma.

snippet.description:

Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/hardy/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@hardy

📱Text me - 39697

Lyrics: 

Two chemical lovers
Met under moonlight
They ain’t hooked on each other
But pretend for the night
After all it’s just nature
Whatever feels right
Then here comes little ole me

I hit the ground running
On the heels of my mother
The young buck with nothing
Who’s old man’s a goner
I grew like a willow
By the end of that summer
I’d been set free

What a wonderful world
What a high of all highs
Drunk on the pure ecstasy of my youth
Well damn would you look at that pretty sunrise

Hell I made it this far
With the hand I’ve been dealt
Might as well go make the best of my years
Might as well go make a name for myself
Oooh
___

Oh it’s been a long December but the wind says winter is rolling down the road
Patiently I’ve been waiting in line, I’m thinking it’s time I get to holding down them rows
The mirror in the water says Heaven knows I owe that favor to the
Architect making me a grown ass baker’s dozen man
With a plan to put a stamp on the land of just goin’ with the flow
Somebody say

How you gonna live (woo)
You grow up in a hurry even when you don’t even try
Whatcha gonna give (yeah)
You’re rolling in the dirt next thing you know there’s years gone by
To the world to the world to the world
As far as I’m concerned by God you only get one life
Damn it feels good to be alive
Damn it feels good to be alive
___

The man in the box
His legend’s in the air
I’ve had my reservations
But damn if he ain’t there
He blends in with the background
With a red tail kinda stare
I’ll never know how but
He’s everywhere

Yeah the man in the box
He’s up before the sun
He looks out of the window at everything he’s done
Groceries for the hungry shelter for the young
Still my premonition tells me I should run

Honestly
What do you what do you want from me
I’m just a guy with a strong determination
To cruise and keep a chasing these tails until
The new crew in town takes my spot
Should I listen
To my county line intuition
Will I be the hero
Or killed on the scene
Tell me this
Does the king of the country keep his
Crown if he locks
(The man in the)
(The man in the)
(The man in the)

The man in the box
I wonder if he knows
When the sun's down and moon’s out
And he’s slippin’ through the rows
With smoke thick from his oak stick like a firefly on his nose
That I can put an end to him
But choose to let him go

Hey man in the box
I’ve wondered all these years
What keeps your on your rusty throne
Is it passion is it fear
Does divine or malign define what’s in between those ears
‘Cause every time I hear thunder someone disappears

Honestly
What do you what do you want from me
I’m just a guy with a strong determination
To cruise and keep a chasing these tails until
The new crew in town takes my spot
Should I listen
To my county line intuition
Will I be the hero
Or killed on the scene
Tell me this
Does the king of the country keep his
Crown if he locks
The man in the
The man in the
The man in the box
The man in the

The man in the box
He’s gotta know I’m starving
I’m run down but this blood hound smells pretty girls at the party
Not for you little number two we’re really doing this aren’t we
Honestly fuck it I’m fucking you up you’re a bitch and my names on the marquis

Man in the box
What the hell have you done
Last thing I heard was
Now there’s blood in my lungs
Is this really how I die
Do you do this for fun
Make me a statue
Like father like son close my eyes
Now I see
After all this time
Maybe the man in the box is me

I give thanks to the Lord
That gave its life today
I respect it in death as I respected in in life
May every part that be used
Be put to good use
And may its sacrifice feed the ones I love
Amen

Lyrics: 

C’mon c’mon
Well woohoo

I know your tryna leave me 
But I ain’t letting you go
I can’t go on with out you
Don’t do this 
I’m crazy
You’re gonna make me lose it
You know I know where you live
But Baby if this is it

If you break up with me I’ll kill myself
And you will bathe in my blood
I’ll put a bomb under the Danbury mall
and shoot myself in the head with a gun

And it’ll be your fault
And it’ll be your fault

Doo Doo Doo doo doo doo
Doo doo doo doo doo doo
Doo doo doo doo doo 
you want me to die

you want me alive

But you were mostly to blame

I’d never have cheated, but
I Ain’t puttin pressure on ya
You’re more than welcome to split
But baby if this is it

If you break up with me I’ll kill myself

and shoot myself in the head with a gun

And it’ll be your fault

When those Innocent People die
Cuz I will actually blow up the mall
their deaths’ll be linked with mine

Doo doo doo doo doo doo
Doo doo doo doo doo 
you want me to die

Doo doo doo doo doo doo

you want me alive

So many people are gonna die because of the things that you’re doing to me now
So many people are gonna die 

And it’ll be your fault

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community.  Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). snippet.description:
Gavin Adcock, Treaty Oak Revival - Us Again (Official Music Video)

THE DAY I HANG IT UP OUT NOW: https://gavinadcock.lnk.to/thedayihangitup

TOUR DATES: https://www.gavinadcockmusic.com/tour

FOLLOW:
Official Website: https://www.gavinadcockmusic.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gavinadcockmusic
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@gavinadcockmusic 
X: https://twitter.com/gavinadcock

Gavin Adcock, dubbed by Billboard as "one of country music’s most buzzed-about artists” is a Georgia native, born and raised in Watkinsville. Former Georgia Southern University football player, Gavin grew up working on his family’s cattle farm and dreamt of riding bulls in the PBR. He started writing songs in high school, but it wasn’t until the spring of 2021, when Adcock tore his knee playing football, that he used his healing time to record and release his first original single. Since then, Gavin has collectively amassed more than 1.5 BILLION global streams across singles including the fan-favorite, RIAA PLATINUM-certified, “A Cigarette,” GOLD-certified songs “Run Your Mouth,” “Deep End,” “Four Leaf Clover” and more. His album, Actin’ Up Again, was crowned the largest major-label country debut from a solo male artist released in 2024 and was the year’s top streaming major-label debut across the genre. Within less than a year, Adcock more than doubled his previous streaming record with over 25 MILLION first week US streams on new album Own Worst Enemy, released August 15, 2025. Own Worst Enemy debuted as the top new Country album on the Billboard 200 Country Chart (No. 4) and top streaming new album on the Billboard 200 All-Genre Chart (No. 14) week of release. The MusicRow Awards “Discovery Artist of the Year” nominee has won over the hearts of both Country music fans and music industry alike, leading to his New Artist of the Year nomination at the 60th ACM Awards. Taking his music to the fans, Adcock continues to sell out music venues from coast-to-coast via multiple headline tours including his Actin’ Up Again (Again) Tour — and recently wrapped 2025 Need To Tour. Gavin’s dedicated fanbase has quickly grown internationally, leading to Adcock selling out his 2025 Canadian Headline tour within one week. In addition to playing a plethora of new headline dates and major festival appearances, Adcock joins superstar Morgan Wallen for the second time as support on 16 dates of Wallen’s Still The Problem Tour 2026.

© 2026 Warner Records Nashville

#GavinAdcock #TheDayIHangItUp #UsAgain #CountryMusic

MORE CHECKPOINT ADVENTURES:

‣ MINECRAFT DIMENSION: https://bit.ly/3mKfUOL

Minecraft is an open world game that has no specific goals for the player to accomplish, allowing players a large amount of freedom in choosing how to play the game however, there is an achievement system. The gameplay by default is first person, but players have the option to play in third person mode. The core gameplay revolves around breaking and placing blocks. The game world is essentially composed of rough 3D objects—mainly cubes—that are arranged in a fixed grid pattern and represent different materials, such as dirt, stone, various ores, water, and tree trunks. While players can move freely across the world, objects and items can only be placed at fixed locations relative to the grid. Players can gather these material blocks and place them elsewhere, thus allowing for various constructions.

snippet.title: Gears of War: E-Day Campaign Review
snippet.description:
Gears of War: E-Day reviewed by Ryan McCaffrey on Xbox Series X, also available on PC.

"By going back to the beginning, Gears of War: E-Day returns to the heart of this series: Marcus Fenix, Dom Santiago, and a Locust horde that’s as terrifying as it is dangerous. E-Day pulls off the tightrope act of giving us a heartfelt prequel with strong characters even when we know how it ends. On a more mechanical level, it also evolves the enemies, weapons, and combat you’d expect to deliver a Gears of War campaign that stands toe-to-toe with any of the others. It wraps up with 10 years still left to go before Marcus gets tossed in prison ahead of the events of the first Gears of War, so here’s hoping the next one stays in the past for a while longer – and that we don’t have to wait another seven years for it to arrive."
